verdict.rationale: LocalAI ships a first-party `local-ai chat` command, described as an agent in your own shell that answers questions, reads files and runs commands behind an approval gate. That directly provides terminal-based chat with a model. The evidence is brief, though: it does not document the interactive session flow, how to pick a model, or how conversation history works. Missing for 10: detailed docs on session usage and model selection for `local-ai chat`, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can start an interactive chat session with a model directly from the terminal

citations.quote: local-ai chat reads your files and runs commands on your machine, behind an approval gate you control.
`local-ai chat`, an agent in your shell that runs commands behind an approval gate.
It answers questions, reads your files and runs commands on your machine, asking you to approve anything that changes state.
